title: Outbreaks Linked to Animals and Animal Products | Healthy Pets, Healthy People | CDC
content: Outbreaks Linked to Animals and Animal Products Overview Below is a selected list from CDC of outbreaks of human infections linked to contact with animals and animal products in the United States. This list is not comprehensive, and outbreaks may have occurred that are not included here.
